shows_en: Cropped frame from Gagaring’s own graduation video of 2026-08-04, showing graduates’ face coverings with a circular emblem reading “STRIKE SPECIAL FORCES…” and “ARKHANGEL”. This is the branding of “Arkhangel Spetsnaza” (@arx_spn, a Telegram channel with 1.02 million subscribers run by VDV servicemembers), which announced an active joint veteran drone-retraining project with Gagaring’s own UAV lab on 2026-08-10; this confirms the mask branding directly, not by visual guess. It is not confirmed whether this is the same brand as “Arkhangel Legion” / “Project Arkhangel”, already linked to this entity’s own training-centre relationship with the 51st Army; this remains a separate open question.
shows: Cropped frame from Гагаринг's own 2026-08-04 graduation video, showing graduates' face-buffs with a circular emblem reading «УДАРНАЯ СПЕЦНАЗ...» and «АРХАНГЕЛ». RESOLVED (2026-09-03): this is the branding of «Архангел Спецназа» (@arx_spn, a 1.02M-subscriber VDV servicemembers' Telegram channel), which announced an active joint veteran drone-retraining project with Гагаринг's own БПЛА lab on 2026-08-10 — confirms the mask branding directly, not a visual guess. NOT yet confirmed as the same brand as the «Архангел Легион»/«проект Архангел» already tied to this entity's own 51st Army training-center relationship (see this entity's tier_basis) — flagged separately below.

shows: Shop front at Горбушка, pavilion С1-042: a sign reading «МАКС 911», «Официальный дилер 3mx», «dji911.com», «С1-042», with a picture of a 3mx case on a light panel. In the window, grey 3mx hard cases are stacked on shelves with DJI boxes and a box marked STARLINK; a black DJI Matrice 4T case stands on the floor. A man in a black cap marked «911», glasses and black T-shirt stands at the entrance with his arms crossed. No caption in the picture names him.
note: Posted by the maker's own channel @ru3mx with post 415 (s9309). The man is at the dealer's own shop and is presumably staff or the owner; not stated, so not captioned as either. Kept internal until the dealer's owner question is decided (no person record, PII policy).

shows: Кадр из видео ER.RU, приложенный к посту фонда: в деревянном ящике стоит чёрный круглый предмет, на крышке которого выдавлены концентрические кольца и лучи; субтитр «Разные новые модели, модификации»; в углу логотип ER.RU и метка «Донецкая Народная Республика». Что это за предмет, кадр не показывает.
shows_en: Frame from an ER.RU video attached to the fund's post: a black round object with concentric rings and radial lines moulded into its lid stands in a wooden crate; the subtitle says “various new models, modifications”; the ER.RU logo and a “Donetsk People's Republic” tag are in the corners. The frame does not show what the object is.
note: First picture of the post's album (message 656). A video frame: the time in the video is not recorded. The post names «ударные дроны и гексакоптеры» and a 3D printer for the two recipients together; this frame shows none of them.

shows: Кадр из видео ER.RU, приложенный к посту фонда: пятеро мужчин в рубашках-поло стоят в цеху у кузова грузовика и открытых деревянных ящиков; позади один держит открытую картонную коробку с мелкими белыми деталями; субтитр «которую мы передаём – большой промышленный 3D-принтер». Логотип ER.RU и метка «Донецкая Народная Республика».
shows_en: Frame from an ER.RU video attached to the fund's post: five men in polo shirts stand in a workshop beside a truck bed and open wooden crates; one in the background holds an open cardboard box of small white parts; the subtitle says “which we are handing over – a large industrial 3D printer”. The ER.RU logo and a “Donetsk People's Republic” tag are in the corners. Nobody is named in the frame.
note: Second picture of the post's album (message 657; the post itself is s9229). A video frame: the time in the video is not recorded. Everyone in frame is read as involved in the handover; nobody is identified from a face.

shows: Eight men in camouflage, most with balaclavas or face masks, pose in a forest clearing in front of an open vehicle trunk holding equipment; one box in the trunk is marked with a letter Z.
note: Group photo of the post «Отряд «Яким» совместно с партией «Единая Россия» передал боевым товарищам из смежных подразделений…». The masks are the men's own; the picture shows no readable marking beyond the Z. Nobody is identified from a face.

shows: Александр Геннадьевич Сидякин — депутат Госдумы (the file's own description): head and shoulders, grey background, dark suit and dark-red tie.
shows_en: Aleksandr Sidyakin, State Duma deputy (the file's own description): head and shoulders against a grey background, dark suit and dark-red tie.
note: Photograph by Karmaks (own work, 28.09.2016), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (licence record L0406). Shown with the credit and licence in the caption; the publish copy is cropped to head and shoulders and scaled to 800 x 1000 from the 3840 x 5760 original (L0405). He is identified by the file's own title and description and by the Wikipedia article that uses it, not by his face; it is the same man as the official portrait on his party's site recorded earlier. 2016: about ten years older than today.

shows: Логотип партии «Единая Россия», as hosted on Russian Wikipedia and credited there to the party's official site (er.ru).
shows_en: Logo of the party United Russia, as hosted on Russian Wikipedia and credited there to the party's official site (er.ru).
note: Not fetched from er.ru: the site did not answer (TLS error, 25.10.2026). Russian Wikipedia holds it as a non-free file under fair use and credits the official site (record L0408). Used to identify the party, as the other company logos are. Replace with a capture from er.ru when the site answers. The publish copy has the file's DOCTYPE removed and its entity names replaced by their values (an artifact host refuses DTD machinery); the drawing is untouched and the original is kept as recorded.

shows_en: ROI.MARKET logo: a red globe with orbit rings, and a crosshair-framed drone mark at its edge.

shows: Мужчина в тёмном пиджаке и белой рубашке без галстука, портрет по грудь на размытом фоне офиса; кадр видео из вакансионного поста канала.
shows_en: A man in a dark jacket and open-necked white shirt, head and shoulders against a blurred office background: a frame of the video in the channel's vacancy post.
note: One full-size frame (544 x 848, taken at 5 s) of the video attached to the project's own post of 23.10.2026 (video itself L0430); the picture is the same for the whole 2 min 58 s, with sound. The post is signed «Руководитель Проекта Архангел Филиппов Михаил Геннадиевич» with his phone and his Telegram handle. The picture carries no caption: the link to him rests on the project's own post and on the owner's choice of this post as his picture, not on his face. The soundtrack was not listened to.

shows: Эмблема канала «Проект Архангел»: надпись «АРХАНГЕЛ — Ангелы на нашей стороне».
shows_en: The channel's emblem, with its motto ("Arkhangel: Angels on our side") in Russian lettering.
note: The channel's public profile picture as served on its public Telegram page, 25.10.2026 (320 x 320). The project's own mark; used to identify it, as the other logos are.

shows: Небольшой чёрный дрон с крылом и хвостовым оперением, подвешенный под крылом крупного серого БПЛА на аэродроме под маскировочной сетью.
shows_en: A small black drone with wings and a tail, hung under the wing of a large grey UAV on an airfield under camouflage netting.
note: The photograph attached to the project's post of 09.10.2026, which says the third generation of «Архангел» can carry up to 3 kg of warhead and that «Архангел» integrates with carrier aircraft. The post does not label the picture; that the black drone is the «Архангел» is the reading of the post and the picture together, not a caption. No person in frame. 590 x 1280 as served by Telegram.

shows: Крыша внедорожника с радиолокационной панелью и поворотной оптико-электронной турелью на стойках, рядом ящики с кабелями; на кадре нет людей.
shows_en: The roof of an off-road vehicle with a flat radar panel and a rotating electro-optical turret on mounts, with cable boxes beside them; nobody in frame.
note: One frame (720 x 1280, taken at 60 s) of the video attached to the project's post of 26.03.2026, which presents the «Слоненок» complex shown at EXPO.UAV (video itself L0434). The post describes a radar, a video-search capture and interceptor launch; the frame shows a radar panel and a camera turret on a vehicle roof, which fits that description but is not labelled in the video. Other frames of the same video show a woman in an «Архангел» patch speaking in the cab and a vehicle with a visible licence plate and bystanders; those were not used. The soundtrack was not listened to.
